summary: 最高风险不是技术失败，而是以“包容”之名替最慢者做决定。官方数据、共同设计、长期人工值守与可撤回预算未落实前，方案只能作为概念建议。

dimensions.label: 数据隐私
dimensions.note: Public-service and robot pilots can create movement, complaint, and service-use data that may identify people.
dimensions.mitigation: Use no face recognition; collect the minimum, aggregate by default, publish retention periods, and offer no-data/non-AI paths.
dimensions.human_review: Independent privacy and cybersecurity review plus public representatives before any pilot.

dimensions.label: 实施复杂度
dimensions.note: Three key areas, public space, robotics, staffing, and multiple authorities create a high coordination burden.
dimensions.mitigation: Begin with six reversible all-stop gates and one scenario per yard; no civil works before baseline and co-design.
dimensions.human_review: Planning, transport, municipal, accessibility, heritage, fire, and operations teams jointly sign each gate.

dimensions.label: 公众接受度
dimensions.note: People may see slow robots or staffed alternatives as inconvenience, surveillance, or technology theatre.
dimensions.mitigation: Publish the purpose, alternatives, stop button, complaint route, and result before scaling; compensate co-design participation.
dimensions.human_review: Residents, disabled people, workers, carers, and small businesses hold a veto at pilot review.

dimensions.label: 运维成本
dimensions.note: Human staffing, accessibility maintenance, device rescue, and independent evaluation are recurring rather than one-off costs.
dimensions.mitigation: No scenario proceeds without a named operating budget, shift roster, maintenance window, and non-AI service owner.
dimensions.human_review: Operator and finance review the full lifecycle cost before procurement.

dimensions.label: 政策不确定性
dimensions.note: Official geometry, statutory controls, road/heritage conditions, and pilot approvals are unavailable.
dimensions.mitigation: Keep every spatial move conceptual and reversible; replace provisional geometry and recalculate the full package when official files arrive.
dimensions.human_review: Organizer, planning authority, legal counsel, heritage authority, and safety regulator must confirm scope.

dimensions.label: 空间争议
dimensions.note: Curb, crossing, rest, robot, event, and commercial uses can compete for the same ground and time.
dimensions.mitigation: Pedestrian and emergency clear paths are non-negotiable; allocate experiments by time and revoke them when slowest-user performance worsens.
dimensions.human_review: On-site access audit and public trial precede any spatial allocation.

dimensions.label: 技术成熟度
dimensions.note: Low-speed robots and AI public-service agents can fail in weather, crowds, edge cases, and ambiguous requests.
dimensions.mitigation: Use bounded domains, physical emergency stop, human takeover, incident logs, and default-off expansion gates.
dimensions.human_review: Domain professionals and independent safety assessors review each scenario.

dimensions.label: 公平与包容性
dimensions.note: A project about the slowest user can still tokenize the people it claims to serve or define them without participation.
dimensions.mitigation: Pay co-designers, test with multiple impairment and language profiles, publish dissent, and let affected groups reject deployment.
dimensions.human_review: Disabled persons organizations, older residents, carers, children advocates, workers, and language minorities co-govern the protocol.
